items.source:
Your skin grows small spikes coated in dark blight.
		When you are hit in melee the attacker starts bleeding black blood for 5 turns that deals %0.2f darkness damage each turn. This effect may only happen once per turn.
		You are empowered by the sight of the black blood, for each bleeding creature in radius 2 you gain 5%% all resistances, limited to %d creatures.
		The damage will scale with your Magic stat.
items.target:
你的皮肤生长出被黑暗和枯萎力量覆盖的尖刺。
		当你被近战攻击命中时，攻击者开始流出黑血，持续 5 回合，每回合造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害。该效果每回合只能触发一次。
		同时，目睹黑血会使你受到强化：2 格范围内每个可见的流着黑血的生物，都使你获得 5%% 全部抗性，最多计 %d 个生物。
		伤害随魔法属性提升。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/talents/misc/races.lua. Fixed source Spikeskin callbackOnMeleeHit applies EFF_SPIKESKIN_BLACK_BLOOD. callbackOnActBase counts visible actors with that effect at distance <= 2, caps at talent level, and sets EFF_SPIKESKIN power=5 per actor; SPIKESKIN applies resists={all=eff.power}.

items.source: Can walk through walls and quake every turn, %d%% more damage and %d%% more resistances.
items.target: 能走过墙体并且每回合引发地震。增加 %d%% 伤害并增加 %d%% 全部抗性。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua. Fixed source CULTS_OVERGROWTH applies inc_damage={all=eff.dam} and resists={all=eff.resist}, in addition to pass-wall movement and quakes on movement.

items.source: When this target is damaged %d%% of the damage will also be done to the source of this effect.
items.target: 当目标受到伤害时，效果来源也受到目标所受伤害的 %d%%。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=tformat. Fixed source MARK_OF_TREASON.callbackOnHit calculates linked_damage = cb.value * eff.power / 100, then calls eff.source:takeHit(linked_damage, src). The source therefore receives the configured percentage of damage received by the target.

items.source: All cooldowns increased by %d%%.
items.target: 所有技能冷却时间增加 %d%%。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=tformat. Fixed source DECAYING_GROUND.long_desc emits this visible status text. All applies to cooldowns without any category exception.

items.source: Covered in defiled blood, healing the source for %d%% of all damage done.
items.target: 被污血覆盖的目标对效果来源造成伤害时，效果来源恢复该伤害的 %d%%。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=tformat. Fixed talent Defiled Blood callbackOnTakeDamage runs on the talent owner: if damage source src has EFF_DEFILED_BLOOD, self:heal(dam * getHeal / 100, src). The marked target therefore damages the effect source, which heals for the configured percentage of that damage.

items.source:
True power is revealed!

All debuffs removed and all talent cooldowns reset on application.

Each turn a radius 2 explosion will occur in a random space dealing %0.2f darkness and temporal damage and destroying any diggable walls.
items.target:
真正的力量正被揭示！

施加该效果时，移除所有负面效果（“其他”类效果除外）并重置所有技能冷却时间。

每回合，一个半径 2 码的爆炸会在一个随机空间爆发，造成 %0.2f 暗影和时空伤害，并摧毁所有可挖掘的墙。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=tformat. HYPOSTASIS_AWAKEN.activate removes detrimental effects except type other and clears talents_cd when applied. on_timeout then creates a radius-2 random explosion each turn with darkness and temporal damage and digs diggable walls.

items.source: Your body can not function properly here, it is slowly wasting away. Each turn you take %0.2f void damage and any new debuff on you lasts %d%% longer. Each turn those penalties increase until the effect is removed.
items.target: 你的身体无法正常运转，被逐渐损耗。每回合你受到 %0.2f 虚空伤害，任何新施加的负面效果（“其他”类效果除外）持续时间延长 %d%%。每回合这些惩罚都会增长，直到效果结束。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=tformat. TOTAL_COLLAPSE ticks VOID damage, then increases both damage and debuff duration penalty. callbackOnTemporaryEffect only extends a newly applied effect when status is detrimental and type is not other.

items.source: All damages except physical reduced by %d as long as %s is alive.
items.target: 只要%s还存活，受到的所有非物理伤害降低 %d 点。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=tformat. HORRIFIC_FORTRESS.activate sets flat_damage_armor={all=eff.power,[DamageType.PHYSICAL]=-eff.power}, so the holder receives a fixed reduction to every non-physical damage type while eff.src is alive.

items.source: The target is overwhelmed by voices from the void, giving them a 20%% higher chance to spawn hallucinations from Dark Whispers and causing them to take an additional %d%% temporal damage from Dark Whispers and Hideous Visions.
items.target: 目标被虚空之声淹没 , 让他们从黑暗低语中产生幻觉的几率增加 20%%，并使他们从黑暗低语和失智冲击中受到额外 %d%% 时空伤害。
items.bounded_fixed_context: Cacophony applies to targets already under Dark Whispers. EFF_DARK_WHISPERS.on_timeout adds temporal damage when EFF_CACOPHONY is present. On a Hideous Visions hallucination death, the SANITY_WARP branch also adds temporal damage when EFF_CACOPHONY is present. EFF_HIDEOUS_VISIONS itself only reduces damage dealt. In both paths cdam is ceff.power multiplied by the underlying damage.

items.source: The target is removed from the normal time stream, unable to act but unable to take any damage. Each turn, negative effects and cooldowns will decrease in duration.
items.target: 目标从常规时间流中移除，无法行动，免疫伤害。暂停结束时，非“其他”类且不会在无时间状态下自行衰减的负面效果，以及技能冷却时间会缩短。
items.bounded_fixed_context: EFF_SUSPEND_BEN.deactivate iterates effects only when not tick_on_timeless, status is detrimental, and type is not other; it subtracts eff.power from their durations. It separately subtracts eff.power from every active talent cooldown. The shortening occurs when Suspend deactivates.

items.source: The target has tied itself to the fate of another. If it dies, it's chosen target will die in it's place and it will be healed by %d for each stack of Fortune and Jinx.
items.target: 目标将自身的命运和另一个人相连，当它死亡时，选择的目标将代替它死亡。 此时，自身的幸运层数和所选目标身上的不幸层数会被消耗；若所选目标有不幸，则按其层数治疗，否则按自身的幸运层数治疗，每层恢复 %d 点生命。
items.bounded_fixed_context: Fatebreaker is applied to the caster and stores the selected target. On fatal damage it consumes the holder EFF_FORTUNE and selected target EFF_JINX. Healing is assigned from holder Fortune first, then overwritten by selected-target Jinx if present; both effects are removed when present.

items.source: The target has %d increased saves and defense, and %d%% increased critical chance.
items.target: 目标豁免和闪避增加 %d（仅 1 层时实际降低，2 层起才如数增加），暴击率增加 %d%%（始终增加）。
items.bounded_fixed_context: EFF_FORTUNE in tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua: activate() sets combat_def/combat_mentalresist/combat_spellresist/combat_physresist to -eff.power*eff.stacks (negative) on first application; combat_physcrit/combat_spellcrit/combat_mindcrit stay positive (eff.crit*eff.stacks) in activate. on_merge() (2nd+ stack) sets all six stats positive using stackCount. Sibling EFF_JINX activate()/on_merge() both consistently use negative sign for the same six stats, confirming FORTUNE activate is an isolated asymmetry, not a deliberate two-branch design. Net effect: while the target holds exactly 1 Fortune stack, saves/defense are reduced by the displayed %d even though crit is genuinely increased by %d%%; from 2 stacks onward saves/defense also become a real increase.

items.source: %d%% chance to stun any foes hit.
items.target: %d%% 几率震慑被击中的敌人；每回合第一次符合条件的命中必定触发震慑，不受该几率限制；之后的命中按该几率判定，且同一目标每回合最多被震慑一次。
items.bounded_fixed_context: EFF_KROG_WRATH.callbackOnDealDamage in tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua: if not target:canBe("stun") return; if self.turn_procs.krog_wrath and not rng.percent(eff.power) then return end — this rng check only runs once turn_procs.krog_wrath is already truthy, i.e. only for the 2nd+ qualifying hit this turn; the first qualifying hit each turn skips the roll and always proceeds. self.turn_procs.krog_wrath[target.uid] additionally blocks a second stun on the same target within the same turn regardless of roll. T_KROG_WRATH.info in data/talents/misc/races.lua already states this in the talent tooltip: "%d%% chance (100%% for the first creature hit each turn) to stun them for 3 turns. This effect can only stun a creature once per turn." The EFF_KROG_WRATH status long_desc (the buff-icon tooltip shown while the effect is active, separate string from the talent info) omits both the guaranteed-first-hit and once-per-target-per-turn facts.

items.source: Linked to their horror ally gaining %d%% all damage resistance.
items.target: 和恐魔建立链接，获得 %d%% 全部抗性。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua. Fixed source WTW_SHARED_INSANITY applies resists={all=eff.resist}; terminology/combat.tsv maps resists.all / All Resists to 全部抗性.

items.source: Empowered by the sight of black blood, granting %d%% all resistances.
items.target: 目睹黑血时受到强化，获得 %d%% 全部抗性。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua. Fixed source SPIKESKIN applies resists={all=eff.power}; terminology/combat.tsv maps resists.all / All Resists to 全部抗性.

items.source: %d stacks, +%d%% to all damage dealt.
items.target: %d 层, +%d%% 所有造成的伤害。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua. Fixed source CHAOS_ORBS is beneficial and applies inc_damage={all=eff.stacks*3}.

items.source: %d pustules increasing resistance by %d%%.
items.target: %d 脓包，增加 %d%% 全部抗性。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua. Fixed source PUTRESCENT_PUSTULE updates temporary resists with {all=new_eff.stacks * new_eff.power}.

items.source: Reduces all damage taken by %d%%.
items.target: 减少 %d%%所有受到的伤害。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua. WARBORN applies resists={all=eff.power}.

items.target: 降低所有受到的伤害 %d%%。施加该效果的时候会解除所有负面效果
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua. GASTRIC_WAVE_BUFF applies resists={all=eff.power} and removes detrimental effects on application.

items.source: Reduces all damage done by %d%% and increase all detrimental effects durations by 6 turns on application.
items.target: 降低所有造成的伤害 %d%%。施加该效果的时候会将所有负面效果持续时间延长6回合。
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua. GASTRIC_WAVE_DEBUFF applies inc_damage={all=-eff.power} and extends detrimental-effect durations on application.

items.source: %s talent '%s%s' is energized by the revelation!
items.target: 启示使%s技能'%s%s'的冷却时间缩短了！
items.bounded_fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=logSeen.
